name: file-upload
title: File Upload
description: A dropzone and file picker for uploading files, with drag-and-drop and a list of accepted files.

props.name: accept
props.description: The accept file types

props.name: acceptedFiles
props.description: The controlled accepted files

props.name: allowDrop
props.description: Whether to allow drag and drop in the dropzone element

props.name: capture
props.description: The default camera to use when capturing media

props.name: defaultAcceptedFiles
props.description:
The default accepted files when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the accepted files of the input.

props.name: dir
props.description: The document's text/writing direction.

props.name: directory
props.description: Whether to accept directories, only works in webkit browsers

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the file input is disabled

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements. Useful for composition.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Whether the file input is invalid

props.name: locale
props.description: The current locale. Based on the BCP 47 definition.

props.name: maxFiles
props.description: The maximum number of files

props.name: maxFileSize
props.description: The maximum file size in bytes

props.name: minFileSize
props.description: The minimum file size in bytes

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the underlying file input

props.name: preventDocumentDrop
props.description: Whether to prevent the drop event on the document

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the file input is read-only

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the file input is required

props.name: transformFiles
props.description: Function to transform the accepted files to apply transformations

props.name: translations
props.description: The localized messages to use.

props.name: validate
props.type: ((file: File, details: FileValidateDetails) => FileError[] | null) | undefined
props.description: Function to validate a file

events.name: onFileAccept
events.description: Function called when the file is accepted

events.name: onFileChange
events.description: Function called when the value changes, whether accepted or rejected

events.name: onFileReject
events.description: Function called when the file is rejected

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Drag and drop files onto the dropzone, or click browse to pick them.

examples.title: Accepted file types
examples.description: Pass `accept` to restrict file types and `maxFiles` to cap how many can be selected.

examples.title: Max file size
examples.description: Pass `maxFileSize` (in bytes) to reject files above a size limit.

examples.title: Change callback
examples.description: Use `filesChange` to read the accepted files whenever the selection changes.
